youtube.aciklama: The best-known genetic cause of enlarged vestibular aqueduct is the SLC26A4 gene. It encodes pendrin, a protein that transports ions in the inner ear and the thyroid gland; its changes also cause Pendred syndrome, in which hearing loss comes with goiter. Goiter usually appears in late childhood or adolescence, and thyroid evaluation is planned by the physician.
